scope: Concrete artifacts across the whole live spine. Authored operation, combination and association edges; live placement and shared scenes are separate evidence.
rules: Nodes are artifacts or explicitly proposed assemblies, not halls or abstract subjects.
A relationship is an editorial learning or creative choice, not proof of code inheritance.
Museum placement is not proof of a reusable Void prefab or a tested lesson.
All other registered map objects remain accessible without inventing a tutorial role.

nodes.title: Painted flow field

nodes.title: Orbiting points

nodes.title: Descent landscape

nodes.title: Hanging cable

nodes.title: Tensegrity frame

nodes.title: Pendulum wave

nodes.title: Unit-circle instrument

nodes.title: Chladni plate

nodes.use: Inspect how excitation changes a spatial pattern.

nodes.title: Seed replay machine

nodes.title: Random-walk terrarium

nodes.title: Galton board

nodes.title: Noise terrain

nodes.title: Noise torus

nodes.title: Voronoi strands

nodes.title: Shaping surface

nodes.title: Pattern surface

nodes.title: Layered-noise surface

nodes.title: Reaction-diffusion surface

nodes.title: Rule explorer

nodes.title: Life dish
nodes.learn: A population can change through a small shared transition rule.
nodes.use: Watch local decisions make persistent patterns.

nodes.title: Growing cell network
nodes.learn: Repeated local changes can extend a connected structure.
nodes.use: Let a network emerge from neighbourhood relations.

nodes.title: Subdividing cube
nodes.learn: A rule can return to smaller versions of its own input.

nodes.title: Koch curve

nodes.title: Menger sponge
nodes.learn: Repeated subdivision and removal make a porous body.

nodes.title: Grammar instrument
nodes.learn: Rewrite symbols, then interpret them as spatial actions.
nodes.use: Edit a generative recipe before drawing it.

nodes.title: Grammar tree

nodes.title: Grammar canopy

nodes.title: Colonising branches
nodes.learn: Growth responds to nearby attractors and existing branches.

nodes.title: Maze generator

nodes.title: Evolving programs

nodes.title: Jelly cube

nodes.title: Reaction-diffusion body

nodes.title: Voxel field
nodes.learn: A scalar sample stores a value, not a mesh vertex.

nodes.title: Surface cases

nodes.title: Merging metaballs

nodes.title: Solid-composition bench

nodes.title: Carved recursive cube

nodes.title: Wedge + cube route
nodes.learn: Joined surfaces can preserve one continuous walking route.
nodes.use: Save a reusable ramp-and-platform assembly, then apply a controller to the same construction in Transformation.
nodes.note: Built on Cube: thirty one-metre cubes and six original wp wedges form two rises and a three-metre-wide route. The same recipe is mounted in the separate Transformation trial. Each member is editable; motion remains the next trial.

carry.keeps: Original six-vertex wp profile and collider; one-metre cube units; named member positions.
carry.adds: Two joined rises, metre joints, independently editable members and a reusable complete assembly.
carry.check: Independent support-ray samples, real desktop/synthetic XR traversal and editor copy/pose tests in Cube and Transformation.

nodes.title: Beam / plank
nodes.learn: Give a segment thickness and collision so it can support a body.
nodes.use: Cross a gap or make a landing.
nodes.note: Source is the existing Void descent assembly; extracting a standard snapped beam remains a design choice.

nodes.title: Two-point gate
nodes.learn: An authored relation between two held points triggers an opening.
nodes.use: Make an interaction condition change access.
nodes.note: Existing Void component, not a standalone registry token. The opening rule is not the definition of a line.

nodes.title: Construction brace
nodes.learn: A triangular arrangement makes edges and joints legible at architectural scale.
nodes.use: Frame an encounter with a full-height triangle.
nodes.note: Existing Void area component; it does not certify engineering load capacity.

nodes.title: Do not cross
nodes.learn: A visible boundary can acquire an instruction and a social meaning.
nodes.use: Guide, prohibit or invite the player to question a boundary.
nodes.note: The interpretation is an association, not a geometric property.

nodes.title: Completed tetrahedron
nodes.learn: Four shared vertices and four triangular faces enclose a body; collision is an additional construction.
nodes.use: Complete the solid, pick it up, and retain its geometry recipe for a physical obstruction.

carry.keeps: The same four positions and face connections.
carry.adds: Matched convex collision and pickup already exist in align_solid.gd.
carry.check: Completion, outward faces, matching collision, pickup and reset.

nodes.title: Striped tetrahedron blocker
nodes.learn: A closed geometric body can refuse a route when it has collision.
nodes.use: A freestanding concrete obstruction using the completed tetrahedron recipe.
nodes.note: Built in the Void Polyhedra obstruction area and reusable in the lab editor. Uses the alignment tetrahedron recipe at 1.8 scale with static collision.

carry.keeps: Tetrahedron vertices and connectivity, at a declared scale.
carry.adds: Striped finish, floor-centred placement and static collision.
carry.check: Native desktop and synthetic XR checks: closed collider, blocking contact and matching striped geometry.

nodes.title: Completed prism wedge
nodes.learn: Two triangular ends and three connecting sides form a prism with six shared vertices.
nodes.use: Build the triangular-prism form before giving it the proportions of a walkable ramp.
nodes.note: A fifth point added to a tetrahedron does not automatically make this wedge. Arrangement and face connectivity are part of the construction.

carry.adds: Six vertices, five polygonal faces and the matching convex collider.
carry.check: Both end faces and all connecting faces close; the visible and physical boundaries agree.

nodes.title: One-metre building cube
nodes.learn: The cube becomes a support when its visible body, origin and collision agree.
nodes.use: A standard one-metre platform that joins the original wp.
nodes.note: Introduced on Cube, after the six-vertex wedge in Polyhedra. Exact one-metre support prefab with matching collision and visible metre joints; not a migration of the tutorial CubeBody class.

carry.keeps: One-metre cube dimensions and the old grid platform-height rule.
carry.adds: Floor-relative origin and matching support collider; reusable editor prop.
carry.check: One-metre mesh and collision; walk from the original wp to the cube landing in desktop and synthetic XR.

nodes.title: A route that changes
nodes.learn: A transform changes access when it acts on the same structure the player can walk on.
nodes.use: A raised ramp-and-cube route over a bounded hazard bed inside the existing tower frame.
nodes.note: The static Cube construction is now present in the separate Transformation trial. Moving parts, hazard bed and passenger-motion tests remain proposed.

carry.identity: Saved wedge + cube assembly, with a movement controller
carry.keeps: Member definitions, local joins, colliders and saved arrangement.
carry.adds: One controlled transform, a bounded hazard and a local checkpoint.
carry.check: Static traversal first; then passenger movement, reset, hazard/respawn and desktop/VR parity.

nodes.title: Striped pyramid blocker
nodes.learn: Four triangular sides and a square base enclose a five-faced solid.
nodes.use: Use its collision and footprint to divert a route.
nodes.note: Built in Void Polyhedra and available under Building solids in the lab editor.

nodes.title: Striped wedge / wp
nodes.learn: The vertical face blocks; the sloped face supports ascent.
nodes.use: Rotate the same original wp to join a one-metre platform.
nodes.note: Built in Void Polyhedra and available under Building solids in the lab editor.
